headword: {近況報告|きんきょうほうこく}

definitions.gloss: update on recent activities; status report on how one has been
definitions.explanation: A report or account of what has been happening recently in one's life, work, or circumstances. Common in letters, reunions, and social media.

examples.japanese: {近況報告|きんきょうほうこく}をお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Please give us an update on how you've been.

examples.japanese: {同窓会|どうそうかい}で{近況報告|きんきょうほうこく}をし{合|あ}った。
examples.english: We shared updates on our lives at the class reunion.

examples.japanese: {年賀状|ねんがじょう}に{簡単|かんたん}な{近況報告|きんきょうほうこく}を{添|そ}えるのが{一般的|いっぱんてき}だ。
examples.english: It is common to include a brief update on your life in New Year's cards.

notes:
A compound of {近況|きんきょう} (recent situation) and {報告|ほうこく} (report). Frequently encountered in reunion settings, letters, and social media posts. In Japanese social culture, sharing {近況報告|きんきょうほうこく} is an important way to maintain relationships.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {近況報告|きんきょうほうこく}をする: to give an update on one's situation
- {近況報告|きんきょうほうこく}を{兼|か}ねて: also serving as a life update
- {簡単|かんたん}な{近況報告|きんきょうほうこく}: a brief status update

RELATED WORDS:
- {近況|きんきょう}: recent situation — the base word; often used in {近況|きんきょう}はいかがですか (How have you been?)
- {報告|ほうこく}: report — the general term for reporting or giving an account
- {消息|しょうそく}: news of someone, whereabouts — more formal; used when you haven't heard from someone in a while
